newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI extends Holter buyback option.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI extends Holter buyback option.

text.p: Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Tuesday it had extended the expiry date of an option for it to buy back 50 percent of the Saarberg-Holter Wassertechnik (SHW) waste water treatment business in Germany with government-owned Saarbergwerk AG.
The option arrangement has been extended to October 31, 1996, from September 30, and would be exercisable within a month after that date, ANI said.

ANI said the original option arrangements were put in place as part of the negotiations between ANI and Saarberg aimed at creating a joint venture between Holter and Saarberg of their environmental engineering activities.
"This option provides for ANI, should it so wish, to acquire the 50 percent interest Saarberg holds in SHW if the negotiations on the joint venture proposal prove unsatisfactory," ANI said.

"The further extension of the option expiry date to 31 October 1996 is designed to enable both ANI and Saarberg additional time to conclude due diligence and final negotiations regarding the joint venture proposal," it said.
"The extension of this option will not preclude ANI from continuing discussions with other interested parties," ANI managing director Peter Stancliffe said in a statement.
ANI shares were down three cents at A$1.03 at 3.20 pm (0520 GMT).
